description.en: Divided by s/n instead of s/√n, forgetting the square root in the standard error.
description.et: Jagas s/n-ga, mitte s/√n-ga, unustades standardvea ruutjuure.

description.en: Subtracted the sample mean from the hypothesised mean instead of the other way around, flipping the statistic's sign.
description.et: Lahutas valimi keskmise nullhüpoteesi keskmisest, mitte vastupidi, pöörates statistiku märgi.

description.en: Multiplied by √n instead of dividing the difference by the standard error s/√n.
description.et: Korrutas √n-ga, selle asemel et jagada vahe standardveaga s/√n.
